title: SIM Card Kiosk
scenario: A kiosk offers tourist SIM cards but asks to photograph your passport and card together.

answers.A: Click/pay immediately to avoid losing the booking or offer.
answers.B: Check inside the official app, booking, provider, or government site.
answers.C: Ignore/report the message and use a known contact route.
answers.D: Forward it to a fellow traveller and ask what they think.

explanation: SIM Card Kiosk: the trap is to collect private data, images, or documents under pressure. The safer move is to verify through an official or approved channel, not to click or follow the risky request.
proTip: Limit document sharing and use reputable providers.
